title: PaymentRequestedMessage
description: Body of a message on the order-payment queue: asks the workers to charge an order whose tickets are PENDING_CONFIRMATION. Message attributes: messageType=PAYMENT_REQUESTED, correlationId, schemaVersion=1. The payment token is an opaque gateway token, never card data. Consumers are idempotent (at-least-once delivery).

orderId.description: Order identifier (also the payment gateway idempotency key).

correlationId.description: Correlation id of the original HTTP request.

occurredAt.description: ISO-8601 instant at which the message was produced.
